name: "Attacks / blocks … if able", "must be blocked if able" and "all creatures able to block … do so" are traits
notes: Requirements (CR 508.1d, 509.1c) were read by nothing (2026-11-19): ~70 targeted units of the behavioural audit were skipped as one-shot, and the static ones (Lure, Goblin Rabblemaster) showed nothing. The can't-rule block of cards-parser.js now also keeps "<verb> [whom] [duration] if able" (duration dropped) and "All creatures able to block X do so" as traits in the card's words. A fired trigger's "blocks it" is the card when the trigger is about the card (Avalanche Tusker, Giant Ambush Beetle), and "this creature" names the card (_resolveTraitText). Legion Warboss gets Rabblemaster's rule (it is a Goblin) and nothing from its own trigger. Not kept: "If this creature attacks, all creatures you control attack if able" (Viashino Bey: it binds only as that attack is declared) and a created token ("That token attacks this combat if able" — Legion Warboss).
